working_tree: uncommitted changes; initially clean; no commit or push
method: Separate Compose project per round, disposable credentials and volumes. Real services. Cgroup memory.current/peak/events and Docker state sampled every nominal 5s plus CLI cost; summary uses maxima per service, including multiple container lifetimes. Do not sum service peaks. No hardware device: real simulator, seeded account/catalog. Browser injects a real HTTP-issued session; does not replace HTTP/WS with mocks. Data/model preservation checked before cleanup via down/up without volumes.

assistant_requests.error_code: not captured in this harness revision

preparation_failures: R1: CLI permissions are strings, not API dictionaries. Fixed exact-scope parsing and tests. Harness cleanup initially lacked bootstrap token placeholder; removed only own project by labels.
R2: Compose build output preceded the UUID on stdout. Harness now parses and validates last line as UUID. No runtime defect; own project cleaned automatically.
limitations: R3 and R4 remain failed rounds; no approval by mixing their successful stages.

R4 confirmed LLM_TIMEOUT at 92.013s after training for accepted free-form input about environments. This is a real unresolved latency/capacity failure, without isolated root cause or OOM. R3 terminal error code was not captured. The summary has equipment counts but no environment count; the general fallback deliberately includes more context. This does not make the input invalid.
R5 is a narrower recovery smoke with a supported equipment fact. It does not revalidate B2-32 corpus or establish an SLA or universal response quality.

Training can reach 1GiB with memory limit events but no OOM in measured rounds. No long-duration soak test or physical calibration. Probes show loop/transport activity, not completion of every calculation.
Runtime and personal volumes/configuration were not activated or modified. Test images/build cache retained.
